name: MarketingPage
description: Mortar public page shell: header, a main region that fills the viewport, and footer.

props.align: "start" | "center" (default "start"; center centres the content in the space between header and footer, for a single hero)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)

contract.usage: Import { MarketingPage } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Pass a MarketingHeader as header, a Footer as footer and the sections as children. The page is at least the viewport's height; the main region grows and longer content scrolls, never clips.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval. Do not set a fixed height on the page or its sections.
contract.accessibility: Renders one <main> landmark between the header and footer, in reading order. Do not nest another main. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook.
